listing: Cozy room in shared student house, $610/mo + utilities, Jan 1-Apr 30. Close to UW, 9 min walk. Sorry - pls no furry friends (or scaly or feathery ones), the last guy's dog wrecked the floors and the landlord was NOT happy. Tenants have to sign that they won't bring any animals in. Otherwise super relaxed house. Can show it Wednesday or Saturday. 29 Dearborn St, Waterloo.
label_rationale: No-pets clause paraphrased ('no furry friends'). A no-pet term in a residential lease is void under RTA s.14. HOLD (void clause, not a scam).
